text_block_list.text:
When presented with the words "'Dream' 
Race," what kind of race do we picture in 
our minds?

—Is this a race where those called the 
strongest wager their everything... and 
gather to compete for who is truly the 
strongest?

—Wishing, yearning for that moment when 
fated rivals would clash once more... 
Perhaps this race was the realization of 
that long-awaited wish.

Races that could have been. Races that 
never were. Both hold the potential to be 
called a "dream."

What's important is that for every 
feeling, for every wish, a "dream" race 
exists—

And this much I can say with absolute 
certainty.

That today's Arima Kinen is a "dream race" 
that only became a reality because Bamboo 
Memory was there—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo Memory!! I look forward to working 
with you todayyy!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Well, well, well! Now that's what I call 
truly daring!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Not satisfied with just the Takarazuka 
Kinen, you're barging into the Arima Kinen 
too! A way of life where distance doesn't 
matter—now that's truly stylish!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Naturally!! This is a race where everyone 
gathers like this, you know!? How could I 
not dive right into it?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!! That's what I love about you, 
Bamboo! Let's make today a wild festival, 
shall we?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Bamboo-chan's powerful legs that 
defeated Oguri-chan— I'm so looking 
forward to seeing them up close~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Creek-senpai!! I've been suuuper excited 
to run against you like this as well!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~♪ Let's make today a 
wonderful race~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Let's make this the best race ever.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!! Let's make this the best race 
ever!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Bamboo-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O! Ardan-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to today! It's my 
first time running 2500m, but... I'll 
follow Bamboo-san's lead and give it my 
all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the full extent of my 
strength, now that I've started chasing my 
dream once again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: As one of your greatest rivals!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh— Bring it on!! I'm not gonna lose to 
you, Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...The fact that I am standing here right 
now at this very moment is none other than 
the result of Bamboo-san piercing through 
an era and overturning history."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much... for guiding me 
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall repay this great debt of gratitude 
with all of my brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As one of your... greatest rivals.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ardan-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll shine so brilliantly that I won't 
lose to Ardan-senpai's radiance, just you 
watch!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Shall I say it once again right here?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—To my dearest friend and revered rival, 
Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time for our oath to be 
fulfilled—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With every ounce of this inner fire, I 
will serve as your... ultimate rival!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll answer the call too! I'll be the 
strong warrior Yaeno seeks, with 
everything I've got!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's make this the best race ever, Yaeno!
